body: Locked tripod commercial product shot in soft morning light. A terracotta kraft coffee bag with the exact label "MORNING ROAST" stands beside a speckled espresso cup on a travertine counter. Keep the bag, label, cup and counter still. Animate only one thin ribbon of warm steam rising and settling back to the starting wisp. No extra text.
